newsitem.title: USA: Cardinal says modem upgradable to 56K,ISDN.
newsitem.headline: Cardinal says modem upgradable to 56K,ISDN.

text.p: Cardinal Technologies Inc on Monday said its new 33.6 thousand bit per second (Kbps) modem can be upgraded to 56 Kbps as well as 128 Kbps Integrated Services Digital Networks, or ISDN, for faster Internet connections.
Modems are hardware that allow computers to communicate via telephone lines.

Cardinal said the modem will use U.S. Robotics Corp's "x2" 56 Kbps technology. The technology takes advantage of the digital connections already in place between the telephone network and equipment used by many Internet service providers and corporate remote access servers.
Cardinal says its new modem will start at about $149 and should be available during the first quarter of 1997.
